title: Focus Furnace — Biweekly Digest
content:
Fortnightly snapshot (2025-02-24 -> 2025-03-03)

Top-line mood: "energized but a little scattered" — good throughput on tiny wins, a couple of context switches cost a day.

Objective A: Ship a defensible prompt-eval harness for hosted-api demos
- KR1: baseline eval suite (30 curated prompts + automated graders) — 1/30 complete (notes below)
- KR2: integrate eval into CI so we catch regressions on merges — blocker: flaky CI container image, needs infra ticket
- KR3: one internal demo with stable prompts by end of Mar — on track if we stop scope creep

Progress notes / why slow:
- Spent 3 days iterating on grader heuristics — got precision up but recall low on edge cases (long-context QAs).
- Need to decide: accept slightly noisy metric (faster) vs deeper labeling (slower). My leaning: ship coarse metric, iterate with follow-ups.
- TODO: schedule 1-hour labeling party w/ Maya + UX to adjudicate 50 edge cases (ask Ravi to run through infra tickets first)

Objective B: Personal craft — reduce distracted context switching, increase focused blocks
- KR1: 8x 90-min focus blocks per week (tracked) — avg last 2 weeks: 5. Mostly late-day interruptions.
- KR2: 3 deep-dive writeups (design notes or postmortems) this quarter — 0/3 (need to reserve slots)

Small experiments (micro-hypotheses) — treat as cheap bets:
- Experiment 1: Block 90-min 1:1 + async follow-ups for cross-team syncs. Hypothesis: fewer meeting-induced context switches. Result: Trial week reduced shallow meetings by ~30%. Keep.
- Experiment 2: Morning zero-email 2 hours for deep work. Hypothesis: higher concentration -> faster PRs. Result: mixed (good but blocked by urgent infra alerts). Idea: pair with SRE on-call rota to align.

Weekly micro-metrics (self-tracked):
- PRs opened: 4
- PRs merged: 3
- Docs started: 2 (eval-spec, demo-flow)
- Time in scheduled focus blocks: 7.5 hours (target 12)
- Interruptions (non-urgent): 9

Who I need help from:
- Ravi: unblock CI image (linked JIRA). If we get stable CI container, KR2 for Objective A can move fast.
- Maya: 1-hour labeling party for grader adjudication — suggest Thu 10–11am next week.
- SRE on-call: propose rotating overlap so my deep blocks avoid pages (talk to Ashwin).

Retrospective — last two weeks
- Wins:
  - Cleared a tricky bug in streaming responses that reduced local flakiness. Good pairing with Eng-Console team.
  - Ran a short brown-bag on prompt evaluation heuristics — good feedback, two follow-ups scheduled.
- Misses / what sucked:
  - Let scope creep on eval suite expand (kept adding new edge cases). Need better acceptance criteria next sprint.
  - Meetings late in day killed two focus blocks — experiment with front-loading meetings on Tue/Thu mornings.

Risks / open questions:
- If we ship coarse evals first, will product accept false positives? Need to capture expected error modes in README.
- How to prioritize labeling budget? Manual labeling is slow; could we pilot a paid labeling micro-batch (100 items) to accelerate adjudication? estimate cost $150–300.

Concrete next actions (my queue):
- A1 (this week): Create clear acceptance criteria doc for eval suite (30–60m) — due 2025-03-05.
- A2 (this week): Create JIRA subtask to stabilize CI image + ping Ravi — assigned to self for now until Ravi confirms — due 2025-03-07.
- A3 (by 2025-03-10): Run labeling party with Maya, produce adjudicated set of 50 edge cases.
- A4 (by 2025-03-17): Wire a lightweight CI check (coarse metric) and gate demo branch.

Notes-to-self (short, messy):
- Keep prompts small at first — long-context graders explode.
- Build a one-pager for demos listing known failure modes (helps set expectations).
- If stuck >3 days, escalate immediately — don’t stew.

Random thoughts / brain dump:
- Could repurpose old benchmark tokens for quick synthetic edge-case generation. write script?
- Consider a weekly 30-min sync with Maya to keep labeling momentum.
- Might be worth logging interruptions category (urgent vs non-urgent) for two weeks to see if we can rebalance calendar.

Slack reminders I want to send this week (drafts):
- @Ravi: Ping on JIRA-REDW-1187 — CI image stability. Any ETA?
- @Maya: Labeling party Thurs 10am? will bring coffee + pizza.

End-of-doc quick scorecard (honest):
- Progress: 25% on Objective A (weighted mostly to KR1/2), 14% on Objective B.
- Confidence: 6/10 (if CI fixes land, we jump to 8/10).

-- Grace

[scratch: earlier note — 2025-02-18]
- Quick idea: Canary eval on dedicated capacity to compare live distribution vs dev env. Might surface post-deploy regressions earlier. Add spike ticket?
